prose_updates.tldr: The proposal directly tests the observed-law null \(d(P)=0\), where \(\mathcal H_\beta(R,\eta)\) is a user-chosen smooth bounded diagnostic class. The ordered support and label-DCT coordinates are known, while the design metric and conditional-expectation operator are estimated. A split convex program and finite-sample projection inequality supply honest size and a lower confidence bound. The fixed-support root-\(n\) upper bound is now matched unconditionally at \(K=2\) under the base link constants, and for every fixed \(K\) under the explicit DCT compatibility condition, because those constructions furnish one common positive cell, marginal, and link slack over \(a\). Under the same DCT compatibility condition, a legal positive-multinomial dense block gives the \(K^{1/4}/\sqrt n\) obstruction when \(K=o(n^{2/3})\) and \(K^{-(a_L+\beta)}\le c_0K^{1/4}/\sqrt n\). The complete growing-\(K\) phase diagram and valid adaptation to unknown \(a\) remain open questions.

project_justification.fill: The project supplies a deterministic-coordinate split projection upper bound and a matched fixed-support \(n^{-1/2}\) converse. The common-design premise is discharged under the explicit DCT compatibility condition for every fixed \(K\), and at \(K=2\) under only the base constants \(c_{\rm link}<1<C_{\rm link}\). It also supplies a legal positive-multinomial dense-block lower bound of order \(K^{1/4}/\sqrt n\) on the stated compatibility and worst-case-tail subregime. The operator-nuisance match, active-face calibration, complete growing-support phase diagram, adaptation factor, and maximal polynomial \(K\) range remain frontier problems.

prose_updates.honest_scope: The formal null is the observed-law condition \(d(P)=0\); \(\mathcal H_\beta(R,\eta)\) is a user-chosen statistical diagnostic class. Wu et al.'s assumptions alone do not place their bridge in this class. Rejection has a causal falsification reading only within applications that separately stipulate this restricted submodel, and nonrejection identifies nothing. The finite-sample split-projection guarantee and lower confidence bound hold over the declared union class. Fixed-support root-\(n\) sharpness is unconditional at \(K=2\) under the base link constants because the explicit zero-contrast positive table has exact link ratio one. For every other fixed \(K\), the displayed DCT compatibility condition explicitly supplies the theorem's common cell, marginal, and link slack; outside these constructions the general fixed-support statement retains its common-design premise. The legal dense lower bound additionally requires \(K=o(n^{2/3})\) and the uniform worst-case tail condition \(K^{-(a_L+\beta)}\le c_0K^{1/4}/\sqrt n\). The operator-nuisance converse, complete frontier, sharp active-face calibration, adaptation factor, and maximal polynomial \(K\) range remain open-ended questions.
